namespace_model.lookup_contract: lookup(population_id, case_pack_id, case_pack_version, candidate_id) then verify content_hash

namespace_model.collision_invariant: same namespace + same candidate_id + different content_hash = COLLISION (enforced at load time)
namespace_model.distinct_identity_rule: same candidate_id + different population namespace = distinct identities (never conflated)
